::: {#sol-twice-calls}

`(dm 2)` calls `(dm 1)` twice, and each of those calls `(dm 0)` twice:

```text
(dm 2)
  (dm 1)
    (dm 0)  returns 2
    (dm 0)  returns 2
  returns 2 + 2 - 1 = 3
  (dm 1)
    (dm 0)  returns 2
    (dm 0)  returns 2
  returns 2 + 2 - 1 = 3
returns 3 + 3 - 1 = 5
```

That is 7 calls, counting `(dm 2)` itself, and 4 of them are calls of `(dm 0)`.
`(dm 2)` returns 5, which is $a_2$.
The two calls of `(dm 1)` do exactly the same work.

:::
